label: NEW BUG
title: Deals | A custom field named "pipeline" overrides the real pipeline: every deal is refused on any pipeline but the default
env: staging-crm.taviportal.com · tenant NDC-Staging · Edge (headless) + API · mahmoud.mahamed1515 (CRM Admin)

panels.caption: Settings › Modules and Fields › Transactions (Deals) › Fields: "Pipeline", API name pipeline, Pick list, Custom Field ✓, only on layout Wonder Travel.
Create Transactions on the STANDARD layout, Pipeline "1" → refused with the custom field's allowed values (25 Oct; same on 26–27 Oct by API).
API: the custom field's pick list validates the real pipeline on every layout; with it widened, pipelines work.

rows: A custom field cannot take a built-in field's api name (Zoho: system api names are reserved; custom fields get their own name)
Custom pick list saved with api name "pipeline" (24 Oct, ndc-staging-owner)
Create a deal on pipeline "1" (Standard layout)
422 "Pipeline: '640e03a4-…' is not one of the allowed values (Standard (Standard))."
Any write that sends a pipeline (create, change pipeline, Mass Update, API)
Validated against the custom field's list on every layout → only "Standard (Standard)" passes, deal lands on the default
Control: custom list widened for the test
Create on "1" stored on "1"; edit moves the deal; stage check still works → the custom field is the cause
Blocked NDC-1302 / 1312 / 1316 / 1324 in round 4 (moved to Bug for this reason)
